scores.notes: Holmes is a lean, clean-shaven man with dark swept-back receding hair, hawk nose and gaunt cheeks in both (left in profile by the bell-rope, right seated in the armchair).
Holmes in both is a gaunt, clean-shaven man with dark slicked-back hair, high forehead and sharp nose (left with cane by the bed, right centre pointing).
Peter (left standing with the net, right lifting the lame man) has the same curly dark greying hair, short grey-flecked beard, weathered tan face and sturdy build in both.

Both show a sandy seabed path between tall teal-green breaking water walls with tan desert cliffs at the shore under a cloudy daytime sky; left is seen from inside the path, right from the shore as it opens.

Jesus on the cross (left, small at the top edge) and standing in the boat (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and slim build; left face is small but no cue conflicts.
David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short curly dark-brown hair, tanned skin and brown tunic with shoulder bag in both (left slinging, right stooping at the brook).
Jesus crucified (left, small) and standing in the boat (right) both show long dark brown hair, dark full beard and lean build; nothing conflicts.
Both show a brown muddy seabed path between parted dark teal water under a dark stormy sky with rocky headlands at the shore; left from the shore as it opens, right from inside with high walls.
Jesus (left small, standing on the water; right standing in the stern) has the same shoulder-length dark hair, dark beard and slim build in both.
Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a long white beard, lean build and a crook staff in both (left walking the seabed, right in profile on the rock).
Moses in both is an old man with swept-back white-grey hair and a full white beard, tanned skin and similar build (left striking the rock, right in profile at the sea).

Left Holmes (throwing the paper ball) has straight slicked-back receding hair and a gaunt middle-aged hawkish face; right Holmes (dark coat, pulling Watson in) has a thick tousled curly mop and a younger, fuller face.
David (left kneeling under the oil, right slinging) is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and rough brown tunic in both; right is small but consistent.

Left shows only the railway station with a smoke column behind distant trees; the house and its grounds are not visible there, so the white burning house, gravel drive and rose bushes on the right cannot be compared.
Peter (left lifting the lame man, right foreground by the fire with hand on chest) has the same curly dark greying hair, short grey-flecked beard, weathered face and brown cloak over pale tunic.
Both show a wooden single-mast fishing boat with a lantern on a dark night sea under heavy cloud with a moon and a hilly shore; the sea calming on the right is the change the descriptions ask for.
Both show a walled garden lawn with rounded topiary, a stone wall, tall trees, playing-card hoops in the mid-distance and mushrooms at the right edge under a soft daytime sky.
Left Holmes (raising the cane) has thin slicked-back receding hair and a gaunt hollow-cheeked older face; right Holmes (with the magnifier) has thick wavy full hair and a younger, fuller face.
Daniel in both is a lean man with short cropped grey hair and a short trimmed grey beard, tanned skin, in a blue fringed robe over white (left before the king, right on the rope).

Peter (left foreground with a net over his shoulder, right second from left with the net) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard and sturdy build in both; skin is somewhat darker on the right but face and hair match.
Peter (left leaping from the boat, right foreground with hand on chest) has curly dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked beard, weathered face and stocky build in both.
Holmes in both is a gaunt clean-shaven man with dark slicked-back hair, high forehead and sharp aquiline profile (left seated tossing the paper, right stooping with the cane).
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short curly dark-brown hair, brown tunic and shoulder pouch in both (left kneeling under the horn of oil, right with the sling).

Peter (left gripping the lame man's hand, right leaping from the boat) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair and a short greying beard in both; the right is somewhat greyer but face shape, hair style and build match.
Jesus is clear on the left (long dark hair, beard, by the tomb) but on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the hilltop cross with no readable face or hair.
Moses in both is an old man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a staff (left beside the priest, right striking the rock).
Peter (left stepping out of the boat, right wading ashore) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly greying hair and a short grey beard in both; right is a little greyer but face and build match.

Left Peter (standing on the prow) has thick dark curly hair with a dark greying beard and looks about fifty; right Peter (diving) has thin receding grey-white hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older.

Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees, tan hills and a lake on the horizon under a warm golden sky; the house is tan mud-brick at a distance on the left and rough stone up close on the right, with a white columned building only on the right, but the layout is compatible.
Daniel (left small among the lions, right hauled up on the rope) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a blue robe over white in both.
Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right wading ashore) has short curly grey hair, a short grey beard, lined tanned face and sturdy build in both.
Daniel in both has short cropped grey hair and a trimmed grey beard with a lean build and blue robe; skin reads a bit darker in the den on the right but face and hair match.

Both show the same dark muddy rock-strewn seabed corridor between towering teal-green water walls at night with a moon in heavy cloud and rocky heights at the far end; a walled town on the right-hand height appears only on the right but does not conflict.

Both show the same kind of wooden single-mast fishing boat on a choppy grey-green lake under dark storm cloud with hilly shores by day; the clearing sky on the right is the change the descriptions ask for.

Daniel (left on the rope, right pointing before the king) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, lean face and blue fringed robe with scroll case in both; skin reads darker in the torchlit hall but features match.
Moses (left in profile with raised arms and crook, right front-centre holding the staff) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in a dark cloak over a pale tunic in both.
Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right leaping from the boat) has short dark curly hair flecked with grey, a short greying beard and a weathered tanned face in both.

Watson (left seated on the right bench, right in the bowler with the doctor's bag) is a solid middle-aged man with brown hair and a full brown moustache, otherwise clean-shaven, in both; the right moustache is a little more waxed but nothing conflicts.

Holmes in both is a lean, clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair, high forehead, hollow cheeks and a sharp aquiline nose (left throwing the paper ball, right with the magnifier); right looks slightly older but features match.

Moses (left striking the rock, right standing with the crook beside the priest) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard, tanned lined face, in a dark brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Both show a brick-vaulted cellar with a flagstone floor and stacked wooden crates leading to a dark arched opening; left adds barrels and more arches, and the darker right is the lantern-screened moment the descriptions ask for.

Both show a sunlit rough lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with big trees, giant mushrooms beyond the hedge at the right and playing-card hoops; the left also shows a stone wall and topiary balls, a compatible other angle.
David (left being anointed, right stooping at the brook) is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with thick dark curly hair, tanned skin, brown ragged tunic and shoulder pouch in both.

Both show a grassy croquet lawn bordered by large leafy trees with a reddish brick garden wall behind and card-soldier hoops in the mid-distance; the right adds furrows and a foreground tree, which is compatible.

Alice (left in the armchair, right drinking in the hall) is a girl of about nine with long straight light-brown to auburn hair, fair skin and round face in both; the hair reads redder under the lamps on the right but length, style and age match.

The enclosing garden wall is red brick with loose orchard trees on the left but grey stone with formal clipped hedges and tall cypresses on the right; both are overcast lawns but the wall and planting conflict.

Moses (left gazing up with the crook, right raising the crook at the rock) is an old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard, lined tanned face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
Daniel (left small, standing among the lions; right being hauled up by ropes) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a blue fringed robe over white in both.
Daniel (left standing at the right of the fiery throne, right on the rope) has short cropped grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, lean tanned face and blue fringed robe with scroll case in both.

Jesus (left standing in the boat, right small on the central cross) has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard and slim build in both; the right figure is small but hair and beard are readable and nothing conflicts.

Right Peter is clear (curly greying hair, grey-flecked beard, stepping off the boat) but the left shows eleven small near-identical dark-bearded men round the fire with nothing that singles out Peter, so there is no figure to compare.

Moses (left seated with arms supported, right seen from behind on the rock) is an old man with long flowing white hair and a full white beard in a dark cloak over a pale tunic in both; the right face is partly turned away but hair and beard match.

Moses (left centre with staff pointing, right raising the rod at the rock) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both; skin reads slightly darker on the right but features match.

Both show a brick barrel-vaulted cellar with a flagstone floor, stacked wooden crates along the walls and a dark arched passage at the far end, lit by a lantern; the right shows more side arches from another angle.

Right Alice is clear (long wavy light-brown hair, blue band, smiling face) but on the left she is small and seen from behind with her face turned away; only long light-brown hair and the yellow dress can be compared.

The left Cat (floating head) is a warm brown tabby with yellow-amber eyes; the right Cat (on the branch) is a silver-grey tabby with green eyes, while Alice's hair stays warm in that image so the grey is not just lighting.
Jesus (left standing on the water, right standing in the boat) has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark trimmed beard, lean face and blue cloak over a pale tunic in both.
Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right leaping from the boat) has short curly grey hair, a short grey beard, lined tanned face and sturdy build in both.

Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees and a hillside town of pale flat-roofed houses with the same white columned building, with the lake beyond under a soft warm sky; left is the road, right the house terrace.
